en.topic_title: Hong Kong whistleblower of student app scandal charged with doxxing
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong woman who sparked a viral academic integrity controversy after questioning the legitimacy of a secondary student’s award-winning app has been charged with doxxing.



Hailey Cheng. Photo: Hailey Cheng, via Facebook.



Hailey Cheng faces four counts of disclosing personal data without a data subject’s consent causing specified harm, according to court documents dated Wednesday.
